hero.h1: Kitchen Remodeling in Raleigh, NC, Priced by the Owner in Person
hero.subheadline: For more than 15 years Affordable Remodeling Solutions has focused on kitchens and baths around Raleigh and Cary. President Jonathan Doering visits your home and builds the estimate himself.

image.alt: Kitchen remodeling Raleigh NC: West Raleigh kitchen with white shaker cabinets, gray island, glass pendant lights and a built-in window bench

intro.h2: Kitchens and baths are the whole focus
paragraphs: Affordable Remodeling Solutions has handled kitchen remodeling in Raleigh, NC and nearby towns for more than 15 years, with bathrooms as the other half of the business. The name describes the goal: good materials and careful work at a fair price, with budget-friendly options when you need them.

When you call or text, you talk with Jonathan Doering, the company's president. Google reviewers describe him spending over an hour looking at every detail of a home before he prices a job, then returning a detailed estimate within days. They also mention Susanne by name for keeping projects organized and on schedule.

services.h2: Kitchen remodeling in Raleigh, NC and bathroom updates

items.name: Kitchen Remodeling
items.blurb: Full kitchen remodels, from galley kitchens that gain counter space to layouts opened up by removing a wall. Recent work includes a Blue Dunes granite galley in Raleigh, a navy-island kitchen in Cary and kitchens in Clayton, Knightdale and North Raleigh. Transparent timelines and cost breakdowns come with every project.

image.alt: Raleigh, NC kitchen remodel with a separating wall removed, white quartz island, stainless appliances and pendant lights

items.name: Bathroom Remodeling
items.blurb: Primary baths, hall baths and condo baths, including showers with frameless glass, freestanding tubs, custom vanities and tile work. After a leak damaged one Raleigh primary bath, the team rebuilt it with soft-green tile, a pebble-stone shower floor and niche, and a warm wood vanity.

image.alt: Raleigh primary bathroom with soft green shower tile, pebble-stone shower floor and niche, frameless glass and a wood vanity

items.name: Garden Tub to Sauna Conversions
items.blurb: That big garden tub nobody uses can become something you will. Affordable Remodeling Solutions has replaced an outdated garden tub and shower with an in-bathroom sauna, a project it describes on its blog for homeowners who want a primary bath that works harder.

image.alt: Cedar sauna built into a primary bathroom in place of a garden tub

about.text: Jonathan Doering leads Affordable Remodeling Solutions, INC as president, and he answers the phone himself. Call or text and you will reach him directly. Over more than 15 years the company has kept its focus on kitchen and bathroom remodeling in the Raleigh-Cary area, with courteous, clean and experienced tradesmen. Reviewers describe Jonathan as detail-minded and personable, and they often thank Susanne alongside him for steady communication. The trades he brings in for drywall, plumbing and electrical work earn their own praise in reviews for being competent and reliable.

image.alt: Jonathan Doering, President of Affordable Remodeling Solutions in Raleigh, NC

process.h2: How a project with ARS gets started

steps.title: Reach Jonathan
steps.text: Call or text (919) 607-5467, or send the consultation form with your ZIP code and photos of projects you like.

steps.title: In-home visit
steps.text: Jonathan walks your space in detail and talks through materials, layout and budget-friendly options before he prices anything.

steps.title: Detailed estimate
steps.text: You receive a written estimate with a clear cost breakdown and timeline, often within a few days of the visit.

steps.title: Build and updates
steps.text: Jonathan coordinates the tradesmen and keeps the work moving, and you are kept informed at every step until the job is done.

service_area.h2: Remodeling across Raleigh, Cary and the Triangle
service_area.text: The office is at 515 S New Hope Rd, Suite 102, in Raleigh. Affordable Remodeling Solutions works in Raleigh, Cary, Morrisville, Wake Forest, Clayton and Garner, and its gallery also shows kitchens in Knightdale and North Raleigh and a condo remodel downtown. If your home sits a little outside that map, ask anyway: one reviewer's small bathroom was outside the usual range, and Jonathan took it on.

items.q: Who will I talk to when I call?
items.a: You will usually reach Jonathan Doering, the president, directly. The contact page invites you to call or text (919) 607-5467 to speak with him, or to fill out the consultation form. Office hours are Monday through Friday, 8:30 to 5:00, and the company is closed on weekends.

Very. One client wrote that Jonathan spent over an hour at the house, looking at every detail including the basement and attic, and delivered a very detailed estimate within a few days. The company says it provides clear timelines and cost breakdowns, so there are no surprises later.

items.q: Can I supply materials or do some of the work myself?
items.a: It has been done. One Raleigh client supplied many of the materials and did a lot of the demolition, and the ARS team took it from there and finished the tile work. Ask Jonathan during the visit which parts make sense for you to handle on your own project.

items.q: How should I prepare for a kitchen remodel?
items.a: The company's planning guide on its blog lists eight decisions to make before demolition, such as what is not working now, whether the layout should change, how storage should match daily habits and choosing appliances early. You can also download the free Project Planning Guide from the website.

items.q: Do you only do full remodels?
items.a: Most projects are full kitchen or bathroom remodels, but reviewers also describe small bathroom jobs, a laundry room and a shower remodel. The consultation form lets you upload photos of your space and of projects you like, which helps Jonathan understand the scope before he visits.

final_cta.h2: Start your Raleigh kitchen with a conversation
final_cta.text: Call or text Jonathan to set up a visit, or grab the free Project Planning Guide first.
